Chilli-Milli Mayo Rolls

Our Chilli Tomato Ketchup is the best way to make rolls even more flavourful.

10 minPreparation
0 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce and garlic.
  2. In another bowl, mix together the red and yellow capsicum, green and purple cabbage, carrot and mint.
  3. Add the vegetables to the mayonnaise mixture and toss well to mix.
  4. Lay a lettuce leaf in the middle of each chapatti and spoon some of the vegetable mixture on top. Roll up the chapatti. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
